seoMeta.title: 1st Contact — Websites that make a great first impression
seoMeta.description: Fast, on-brand small-business websites, server-rendered and instantly editable.

subhead.text: On-brand sites that load instantly and update in seconds.

heading.text: Built for the people you serve

content.body: Your customers meet you online first. **1st Contact** turns that moment into a booking — with pages that are quick to load, easy to read, and effortless to keep current.

1. Pick a starting point.
2. Drop in your words and pictures.
3. Publish. Every version is kept, so you can always roll back.

content.tagline: Websites that make a great first impression.
